footer.disclosure: {name} makes finished videos from the materials you bring: your footage, your words and your brand. Running it means sending some of your material to third-party APIs: AI providers for generation, a storage and hosting provider for your files, and a payment provider for billing. Google is one of them, used only for optional sign-in and Drive sync. Our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> describes what is sent to each provider and why. We do not use Google APIs or any other third-party AI service to generate non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) or any sexually explicit content.
